subject: Excluding non-significant paths to improve the model fit under the AIC framework

messages.author: b48ebf16ed4cffef
messages.subject: Excluding non-significant paths to improve the model fit under the AIC framework
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have a doubt about how should I begin to exclude the non-significant paths from my saturated model using a backward elimination? Should I use the path's estimate-value or z-value in the Lavaan package? After eliminating all non-significant paths, I want to use the model selection via AIC because there may be some indirect paths that should be kept in the model, but it has been excluded.

Thank you.
